messages:
Alex (Customer): Hey team — renewal question. Finance is pushing to switch to a 9-month term and pay via corporate card instead of issuing a PO. Can we make that work and still keep a similar price?
Maria (CS): Thanks Alex. We currently have a 12mo committed quote on file. Changing term usually affects discount. Sharing details to check options.
Sam (Account): Quick note: quoted pricing was tied to 12-month commit with a 15% discount. For 9 months we'd normally reduce to ~8% discount. Rough numbers: `12mo list $70,000 -> $59,500 (15%)`, `9mo list $52,500 -> $48,300 (~8%)` — need final calc from finance.
Jeremy (Finance): If they want card, we can accept one-time card for the renewal, but need the billing contact and amount authorized. Also need vendor code for PO vs card. If they choose card, payment must clear before service changes.
Li (Legal): Changing term requires an amendment. If they want shorter term but same effective price, we need approval from legal for deviation. Small tweak to clause 2.1 (term) and signature via DocuSign OK.
Maria (CS): Two paths: 1) 9mo with adjusted pricing (fast) or 2) keep 12mo economics but issue a 9mo amendment with a prepaid invoice (requires finance + legal signoff). Which does Alex prefer?
Alex (Customer): Ideally keep the lower price but finance can't get a PO out fast enough — card payment would be faster. They'll approve card if we can lock price for the term.
Sam (Account): Can we offer a one-time promotional credit to bridge the delta? e.g., apply $2,500 credit to match 12mo effective unit cost for this renewal only. Need manager sign-off.
Jeremy (Finance): Manager sign-off needed for credits. If we do a credit, I need the credit memo details and to route through accounting. Also confirm tax handling if card vs PO.
Li (Legal): If we go credit + card, doc to sign: amendment + credit memo. I can draft a short amendment template and send to DocuSign once approved.
Maria (CS): Action items: Sam to get manager OK for $2.5k credit, Jeremy to confirm invoicing flow for card + tax, Li to draft amendment template, BillingBot to hold invoice until confirmation. Alex pls confirm billing contact and last 4 of card (or preferred payment method).
Sam (Account): I'll ping my manager now.
Jeremy (Finance): FYI — vendor code needed if they later convert to PO. Ask customer for vendor ID now to avoid churn.
Alex (Customer): Billing contact is beth.billing@acme.com. Vendor code is ACME-00123. Card team prefers a single-charge link.
BillingBot: Invoice hold placed: awaiting payment method confirmation.
Maria (CS): Thanks — if manager approves the credit I’ll coordinate with Li/Jeremy and get DocuSign ready. Target: get signed and charged by EOD Friday to avoid service gap.
Sam (Account): Manager verbally ok'd the credit. Will follow up in writing.
Jeremy (Finance): Noted. I'll prepare one-time payment instructions and the credit memo draft.
Li (Legal): I'll prepare amendment and include the credit memo reference. Will send via DocuSign when ready.
Alex (Customer): Appreciated. Will confirm card details offline.
Maria (CS): Great — I'll update the renewal record and create the amendment task in Salesforce. Keeping this thread open for any blockers. :thumbsup:
